# Metrics Review

Use this when selecting metrics, reviewing model or agent performance, or changing risk gates.

1. Read `.github/agentic-ai/METRICS.md`, `.github/agentic-ai/TOOLING_MATRIX.md`, and the AI Ops inbox.
2. Separate existing definitions from human decisions still needed.
3. Present questions together before enforcing new thresholds or capture locations.
4. Recommend minimal metrics that answer a decision, with risks of gaming or false precision.
5. Create inbox items for Secretary, Dev Ops, or Typewriter when decisions need coordination or documentation.

Output: decision options, recommended metrics, human questions, and follow-up inbox items.
